We're introducing a number of changes across the ComBank Yellow and Credit Card programs as we evolve how customers are recognised and rewarded for their banking relationship.
While we'll cover each change in detail, they all support a simpler and more flexible rewards experience for customers.
The biggest change for Yellow is that from 1 October we'll be introducing ComBank Yellow Points, unlocking a whole new world of points and perks for our customers.
Eligible customers can earn ComBank Yellow Points based on their relationship with the bank.
Whether they're taking out new products, renewing existing ones, making purchases on eligible cards or reaching key banking milestones, customers will have more ways to be rewarded.
The biggest change will be for customers who currently earn points through a ComBank Awards Credit Cards.
Eligible customers will transition to earning ComBank Yellow Points.
The number of points earned on eligible purchases will depend on the customer's ComBank Yellow tier – ComBank Yellow Plus, Gold or Diamond.
This means customers can now be recognised for more than just transactions, earning points across a broader range of banking activities and relationships.
For the first time at ComBank, customers will also be able to earn Yellow Points when shopping with participating brands' digital stores that are accessible in the app through the ComBank Yellow Hub.
In addition to the new brand digital stores, from 1 October, customers will also be able to earn CommBank Yellowpoints by activating offers in the CommBank app from an expanded network of partners.
It's important to know this is in addition to the points earned through eligible credit card products and that this feature will be replacing the current cashback offers.

Once customers have generated a points balance, they can redeem their CommBank yellow points their way across daily essentials, travel, shopping, gift cards and more, through the new redemption portal.
Making sure we're giving customers choice in how they want to be rewarded.
Customers can also transfer their points to partner loyalty programs they already use.
Plus, they'll enjoy exclusive offers, discounts, and pre-sale access to some of the best shows, events, and experiences in town.
